checks: Actual discovery reader, source journal, queue settlement and message engine retain a message from a discovered folder.
Hidden folders included; search folders excluded while their physical children remain discoverable.
Repeated folder observations do not enqueue again after the original message job completes.
Matching active jobs reused; conflicting authority or queue identity rejected.
Partial insert failure and expired lease roll back dispatches, queue children and completion while retaining source pages.
Two workers observed contending on the same settlement recover identical receipts and one dispatch decision.
Paused binding denies new token/provider work; retained completion remains recoverable.
Application roles denied direct dispatch-table/helper access; retained decisions immutable.
Migration rollback restores prior function; owner/execute grants preserved; populated old discovery completion requires explicit backfill.

limitations: Synthetic Graph and account/queue dependencies; not full target-schema or hosted acceptance.
No Microsoft credentials, live provider requests, production writes or activation.
Credential ports, worker/controller registration, recurring discovery/capture, canonical projection and real-mailbox acceptance remain unfinished.
